description: Join us in writing the most beautiful chapter of our lives. Your presence is the most precious gift we could ever receive.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.description: From being classmates, to being lovers, and now inseparable partners.

story1.title: Our Story
story1.content: We met on a rainy afternoon in August. Linh was struggling with her broken umbrella, while Vinh happened to pass by. A hesitant greeting, a smile exchanged, and the rest became history.
story1.subContent: We have gone through nearly a decade together, facing countless ups and downs. We realized we cannot live without each other. On the day Vinh knelt down to propose under the starry sky, Linh knew this was the most peaceful harbor of her life.

story2.title: The Untold Story
story2.content: Linh's mother once told a story about a young man riding a "cà tàng" Sirius, wandering around the gate for several laps. Mother found it suspicious and turned to ask:
story2.subContent: Hey Linh, which guy is riding that Sirius, with dark skin, curly hair like instant noodles, always peering at our house like he's collecting debts?
story2.subContent2: After hearing this, Linh pouted and complained:
story2.subContent3: Oh, that guy named Vinh from our school. He looks so hateful, even if you give him gold, he won't take it!
story2.subContent4: . But Linh didn't know that the young man "curly-haired debt collector" that day was wandering around with a very clear purpose: to win over his beloved daughter.
story2.subContent5: As our grandparents said, "What you hate is what heaven gives you." And here it was heaven forcing us to accept the whole package of "dark skin, curly hair" plus that Sirius!
